title: CatalogItem
description: One item a provider takes requests for, such as one row of a city's list of bulky waste items and fees. Items it does not take can be listed too, with where to take them instead. With a service time, an amount and skills, the values of a request can be computed from its items. The name and description can be given in several languages (LanguageProperty).

@context.description: JSON-LD context of the entity, optional: a context URL or a list of context URLs

name.description: Name, per language (for example {"ja": "ソファー（2人以上用）", "en": "Sofa (two seats or more)"}); the Japanese as the provider's list writes it

serviceCode.description: The kind of request, as a code the provider sets (for example bulky-waste); Open311 service_code

localGovernmentCode.description: Local government code (全国地方公共団体コード, 6 digits) of the municipality responsible; Open311 jurisdiction_id

provider.description: The organisation that does the work (a municipality, a contractor)

category.description: Category: the provider's section, or a short word such as furniture or appliance

keywords.description: Words to find it by, such as other names

accepted.description: Whether it is taken with this kind of request; for an item that is not, alternative says where to take it

alternative.description: Where to take an item that is not taken (home appliance recycling, the shop that sold it)

sizeNote.description: Size condition, as the provider writes it (for example 幅90cm以下, width 90 cm or less)

serviceDuration.description: Time spent at the place, as an ISO 8601 duration (for example PT5M); the service time of route optimisation

load.description: What it takes of a vehicle's capacity, one number per dimension; the provider sets the dimensions and units and keeps them in step with the vehicles' capacity (for example [volume units]); the amount of route optimisation

skills.description: What the work needs (for example two-person, carry-out); the skills of route optimisation, matched against a vehicle's or crew's skills. The provider sets the words

validFrom.description: From when this entry (its fee, for example) applies

validThrough.description: The last day this entry applies

source.description: Where the data comes from (a URL, for example)
